name: Boiled Rice Pudding No. 2
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: raisins stoned and cut in halves
ingredients.originalText: half a pound of raisins stoned and cut in halves

instructions.text: Wash two teacupfuls of rice and soak it in water for half an hour
Turn off the water and mix the rice with half a pound of raisins stoned and cut in halves
Tie the whole in a cloth, leaving room for the rice to swell to twice its natural size
Boil two hours in plenty of water

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Wash two teacupfuls of rice and soak it in water for half an hour
2. Turn off the water and mix the rice with half a pound of raisins stoned and cut in halves
3. Add a little salt
4. Tie the whole in a cloth, leaving room for the rice to swell to twice its natural size
5. Boil two hours in plenty of water
6. Serve with wine sauce
